question: What ritual actions must accompany abandonment of an old damaged liṅga?
premises: An old liṅga may need to be abandoned
The weapon mantra must be recited
inference: Abandoning the old liṅga requires reciting the weapon mantra according to scripture
uncertainties: śāstreṇāstraṃ taken as reciting the weapon according to scripture
plain_english: Having abandoned the old one, reciting the weapon mantra according to scripture.
